papers.title: Reconfiguration of the Cognitive Control Network Induced by Cerebral and Cerebro-Cerebellar Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation.
papers.reason: The paper appears to study neuromodulation-induced changes in the cognitive control network, directly relevant to neural mechanisms of executive function.

papers.title: Reorienting TMS treatments for fear memories and posttraumatic stress disorder. The emerging potential of the anterior prefrontal cortex.
papers.reason: The paper focuses on TMS treatment of fear memories and PTSD rather than modelling or assessing planning, working memory, attention, or cognitive control.

papers.title: A parsimonious, age-invariant, and psychometrically validated neural signature of task-control network functioning
papers.reason: This paper directly characterizes frontoparietal and dorsal attention task-control network activity linked to cognitive ability, symptoms, and goal-directed behavior, making it highly relevant to neural modelling of executive function.

papers.title: The role of world knowledge in sentence comprehension under working-memory constraints: An fMRI study
papers.reason: This human fMRI study examines phonological working-memory constraints during language comprehension, but its main contribution is sentence-processing neuroscience rather than executive-function modelling.
